restored_original_annotations.reason: I reconsider my freshly frozen PF positive to uncertain and accept retirement of the accepted positive. Full-thickness ulcers establish depth, and the PF localization is explicit. However, de distribución difusa describes where plural ulcers or their secondary bone changes are distributed; it does not state the dimensions of any deep ulcer, confluence, or a broadly depleted cartilage sheet. My source freeze conflated widespread distribution with the extent of a qualifying cartilage-loss region. Many separated small deep ulcers remain compatible with this exact wording. The grade3/4 summary does not resolve that extent gap; it also does not negate the full-thickness finding. This is a real post-comparison revision prompted by the root extent objection and the preserved original rationale, not independent source-pass agreement. Restoration to uncertain is justified by the omitted region extent, without a new diagnosis or a claimed universal rule that all qualitative diffuse cartilage loss is inadequate.
